dct_title_s: Ocean Features, Navigation Lines (Digital Map Database of China)
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This line coverage contains coral reef and navigation line ocean features for the national and international waters of China. Lines represent actual shipping lanes or serve as representative paths in open water where no defined shipping lanes exist.

Purpose: This data is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and to provide users with geographic data for cartography, hydrographical analysis, and other types of geographic analysis as needed. Data can be used with geographic information systems (GIS) software to display and analyze information on navigable waterways, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data.
